facts.text: Andrew expressed admiration for birds, specifically noting their ability to soar and explore new spots.

evidence.quote: I've always been awed by birds. Their power to soar and explore new spots is amazing.

facts.text: Andrew mentioned that eagles have always mesmerized him due to their strength and grace.

evidence.quote: Eagles have always mesmerized me; they're so strong and graceful!

facts.text: Andrew shared an image of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them.

evidence.quote: [image: a photo of two birds flying in the sky with a sun shining behind them]
